_locale_guidance: Default supported_locales is ['en']. To ship a wrapper for international metrology compliance, extend to the UN-6 set: ['en','fr','es','ru','zh','ar']. For Canadian regulatory deployment include at minimum 'en' and 'fr' (BIPM and Measurement Canada bilingual requirement). Add 'locale_quality' block declaring per-locale translation status (canonical | reviewed | draft_pending_review | machine_translated). See HCI-CNQ/wrappers/WRAPPER_SCHEMA.md §11.1 for the convention.

name.en: Replace with your domain name (e.g., 'Geochemical basalt analysis')

description.en: Replace with a short description of what this wrapper interprets and for whom.

domain_metadata.author: Replace with your name or organisation

t_axis_label.en: Replace with what the trajectory dimension represents in your domain (e.g., 'depth (m)', 'time (years)', 'temperature (K)')

display_name.en: Replace with display name for this carrier

_example_carrier_id_1.units: Replace with units (or remove this field)

display_name.en: Replace with what S means in your domain (or remove this entry to use engine default)
